G-TD03/001EN
Flower Princess of Spring, Arborea
G Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 4｜ Power 15000+｜ Shield -
Updated: Text
[Stride]-Stride Step-[COST][Choose one or more cards from hand with the sum of their grades being 3 or greater, and discard them], and [Stride] this card on your (VC) from face down.
[ACT]G Zone:If your vanguard is a grade 3 "Ranunculus Flower Maiden, Ahsha", and you did not get an Imaginary Gift this fight, [COST][choose one or more cards from hand with the sum of their grades being 3 or greater, and discard them], and [Stride] this card on your (VC) from face down. Then, [COST][turn a card from G zone with the same card name as this unit face up], and you get two Imaginary Gift:Force.
[CONT](VC):This unit's "when attack hits" effects activate even if the attack did not hit.
[AUTO](VC):When this unit's attack hits a vanguard, choose one of your rear-guards, search your deck for up to one card with the same card name as that unit, call it to (RC), and it gets [Power] +2000 until end of turn. Shuffle your deck.

G-TD03/002EN
Ranunculus Flower Maiden, Ahsha
Normal Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 3｜ Power 11000｜ Shield -
[CONT](VC)[Generation Break 2](This ability is active if you have two or more face up G units in total on your (VC) or G zone):All of your units get "[CONT](VC/RC):During your turn, if you have another unit with the same card name as this unit on your (VC) or (RC), this unit gets [Power] +5000.".
[AUTO](VC):[Counter-Blast 1] During your turn, when your G unit [Stride], you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your rear-guards, search your deck for up to one card with the same card name as that unit, call it to (RC), shuffle your deck, and the unit called with this effect gets [Power] +2000 until end of turn.
